start: Member with a plan, today's routine not done, no workout open

must_not: Another member's or an old routine name

user_sees: Today's routine starts in one tap
must_not: A workout started by a link without the widget key

steps.action: Long-press the icon again during the workout

start: Member wants to log body weight

steps.action: Long-press the icon, tap "Log body weight"
must_not: The home screen with no Measures
A weight saved without the member typing it

start: Member dragged "Start" onto the home screen as its own icon

steps.action: Tap the home-screen copy the next day
user_sees: It starts that day's routine (kept up to date)

must_not: A workout started with an empty routine

start: Member erases all data in Settings

steps.action: Erase all data, then long-press the icon
Tap a shortcut dragged to the home screen before the erase

start: Phone handed to someone else, home screen visible

user_sees: Only the routine's name and "Log body weight"
must_not: The member's body weight or past weights shown in the shortcut
